## Where I am
PR #418 (dashboard grid v2) is merged; the follow-up for keyboard move/resize and a visible focus ring is on branch `tom/dashboard-keyboard`, committed as 8f1a2c7 and open as PR #423 for Priya's review. The `dashboards_v2` flag is on for the Zest Grocers workspace in staging so Priya can rehearse the demo; production is untouched. The visx migration was abandoned: PR #401 is closed and charts remain on recharts. (source: d4-05, d4-07)

- [in-progress] PR #423 "Dashboards v2: keyboard move/resize + focus ring" is open and awaiting Priya's review (source: d4-05)
- [next-step] Merge PR #423 once reviewed, then flip `dashboards_v2` on in production — the user will do that himself on the morning of the 24th (source: d4-06)
- [failed attempt] dnd-kit `KeyboardSensor` on top of react-grid-layout: both libraries handled the same pointer/key events, so every move applied twice and mouse drags fired two layout changes; the dependency was removed (source: d4-02)
- [decision] Implement keyboard handling with a custom `useGridKeyboard()` hook over the layout state, no dnd-kit (source: d4-04)
- [decision] Keep recharts and close the visx migration for good; two chart libraries are not wanted and there is no time to rewrite 9 charts (source: c3-03)
- [decision] Enable `dashboards_v2` only for the Zest Grocers workspace in staging for the demo; production is handled separately (source: d4-06)
